name: Tokyo → Osaka → Hokkaido
tagline: Always together: 4 nights in east Tokyo, one short Hakone–Fuji car trip, an Osaka apartment with a night in Nagoya and a last ryokan night in Nara Park, and 4 nights in Hokkaido.
summary: 4 nights in Kiyosumi-shirakawa (east Tokyo) with a slow day around the hotel and Akihabara, a full anime day and a Girls Band Cry day in Yako and Kawasaki, where Pegasis picks up a car for Yokohama Chinatown, Daikoku, the Turnpike and Fuji. One Fuji-view villa night, then the car goes back at Mishima and a direct Kodama takes you to Osaka for the Nara hill fire. Suzuka, then one night in Nagoya and a full day at Ghibli Park; back in Osaka for Kyoto, Den Den Town and a Matsusaka beef dinner, and a last ryokan night inside Nara Park. A JAL flight from Itami to Hokkaido: 2 nights in a container house in Niseko town for skiing (Pegasis teaches Aoki), the Rusutsu drift course, then 2 nights in Sapporo, and a Peach flight to Narita for both flights home. You do everything together, every meal has a named place, and every train and bus has its departure time.

who.pegasis: In: 23 of 25 WANTs. Daikoku (you drive, no guide) + Tatsumi, Turnpike, Taikanzan, Otome Pass, Gotemba outlets (plain shopping, 45 min), TMG view, airport bus instead of N'EX, Omoide/Golden Gai, Isetan half-price food, Radio Kaikan, Maidreamin, Ikebukuro goods route, Nakano, SHELTER with a live show, Nara hill fire, Suzuka EV kart and the Tokaido car road (as Hakone–Fuji by car + Suzuka + Nagoya), Niseko Grand Hirafu, Rusutsu drift (30-min self-drive course at 15:00), GARAKU, Moiwa, Daruma. Out: Asahiyama penguins (5 h of travel), Onuma (2 h south of Niseko, a whole extra day). Your maybes in: Lake Kawaguchi, Shibuya Sky, the Kawasaki GBC walk. Because you travel together, you now also join some short stops you marked not interested: Suga stairs (15 min), Nissan Crossing (20 min), Enoshima (1 h), Fuji Motorsports Museum (1 h), Toyota museum (1 h 20), Fushimi Inari and Kinkakuji (a calm morning, not at dawn). Nijo Market is out (no split on the last day).
who.aoki: In: about 43 of 49 WANTs. Omoide/Golden Gai, Suga stairs, Tokyo Station dome and Hachiko (GBC Tokyo), Nissan Crossing, TMG, Radio Kaikan, ZEST, Nakano and used goods, Ikebukuro, Shimokita and a SHELTER live show, Shibuya Sky at sunset + Nintendo/Pokémon + Harajuku, the Kawasaki GBC stamp walk, Daikoku + Tatsumi, Enoshima + Slam Dunk crossing, Hakone as Tokyo-3, Fuji Motorsports Museum, Lake Kawaguchi, Hanz villa, Yuru Camp Motosu, Nara fire, Suzuka, Toyota museum, Fushimi Inari + Kinkakuji (not at dawn, so Pegasis can join), no Sabbat places (they are only for looking, so they are out), Namba food, Den Den Town, Liberty Walk, Donki coupon, one and a half ski days at Niseko on the beginner area (Pegasis teaches you, no paid lesson), Rusutsu drift (back seat), Moiwa, Daruma. You also join Pegasis's Taikanzan and Gotemba outlets (short stops you marked not interested). Yokohama Chinatown (dinner before Daikoku). Out: Cup Noodles Museum (it closes at 18:00, too early for the Kawasaki day), Fujiten ski (Niseko instead), the paid maid-café tour (the Akihabara maid café instead), Cape Kamui (path closed in winter), Aokana/Goto (off route), Toyota Kaikan (closed Sundays). Uji is skipped because you marked it not interested.

places.blurb: The red-railed stairs from the last scene of Your Name. Early morning is quiet.

tips: Check the site for the cars on show in January 2027.

places.ja: 思い出横丁
places.blurb: A narrow alley of tiny yakitori bars beside the Shinjuku tracks. Each bar has 6 to 12 seats.
tips: Golden Gai (新宿ゴールデン街) is 8 min east: one drink there before Don Quijote.
Banpaiya standing bar: drinks from about ¥290.

places.ja: ドン・キホーテ 新宿歌舞伎町店
places.blurb: Open all night, 3 min from the hotel. Pegasis buys the suitcase for the way home here; Aoki can use the tourist coupon.

info.label: Tax-free
info.value: From ¥5,000 before tax, passport; tourist coupon on the Donki app

info.label: Small items
info.value: Heat packs カイロ 10 pcs ≈ ¥400–700 · shoe spikes 靴用滑り止め ≈ ¥1,000–2,000 · plug adapter ≈ ¥500

Buy a 60–70 L suitcase with 4 wheels: it must hold everything Pegasis buys until Feb 1.

places.ja: 東京都庁 展望室
places.blurb: A free observation deck 202 m up in the city hall tower. On a clear winter morning you see Mt Fuji.
tips: Go in the morning: Fuji is clearest before noon in winter.

places.ja: 秋葉原ラジオ会館
places.blurb: 10 floors of figures, trading cards, model kits and anime goods, opposite Akihabara station.

info.label: Station
info.value: 秋葉原駅 電気街口

tips: Akihabara ZEST (Oshi no Ko, 秋葉原ZEST) is 3 min north: look from outside.
Do not follow street touts for maid cafés.

places.ja: めいどりーみん 秋葉原本店
places.blurb: The big maid café chain, with a small stage show. First-timers get a 'passport'. No table charge.

info.label: Cost

tips: Book on the official site.
Walk past street touts: go only to real shops.

places.en: Ikebukuro anime goods route (Animate main store, Surugaya, K-BOOKS)
places.ja: アニメイト池袋本店・駿河屋・K-BOOKS

tips: Route: Animate → Stellaworth (2F, across the road) → Surugaya 1F + Lashinbang 3F → K-BOOKS buildings toward Sunshine City.
Eat lunch in the Sunshine 60-dori side streets.

places.ja: 中野ブロードウェイ
places.blurb: A 1960s shopping building. Floors 2 to 4 are full of used figures, manga and toys, with many Mandarake shops.
tips: Go after 13:00: many small shops open late.

places.ja: 下北沢（ぼっち・ざ・ろっく！聖地）
places.blurb: Bocchi the Rock's home area: the station, Honda Theater, Donguri Hiroba park (ep 4) and the Senrogai empty lot (ep 5), plus used-clothes and record shops.
tips: You arrive after dark: the shopping streets are lit and busy until about 20:00.
Do not photograph private houses.

places.ja: 下北沢SHELTER
places.blurb: The real live house behind STARRY in Bocchi the Rock. You go inside for an evening show, like Kessoku Band's first live.
tips: The Jan 20, 2027 line-up appears about December 2026: buy the ticket then (pick up at 7-Eleven or FamilyMart).
Standing only. Enter by the number on your ticket.
When you buy the ticket, note the OPEN time and end the Shimokitazawa walk 15 min before it.

places.ja: SHIBUYA SKY（渋谷スカイ）
places.blurb: An open-air roof deck 230 m above the Shibuya Scramble. A morning slot is the cheap web price and has the clearest Fuji view.

info.label: Sale
info.value: Web tickets open about 2 weeks ahead (about Jan 7)

info.label: Nearby
info.value: Shibuya PARCO 6F: Nintendo TOKYO and Pokémon Center, 8 min walk

tips: The roof closes in strong wind or rain. Check in the morning.
After: Hachiko statue and Spain-zaka (Girls Band Cry ep 3) are 5 min on foot.

places.ja: ラゾーナ川崎プラザ ルーファ広場
places.blurb: Girls Band Cry: the open square where the band plays on the street. Start the GBC stamp tour here.
tips: Island Mura Guitars closed on Sep 23, 2026: check the new stamp list in January 2027.

places.ja: 多摩川見晴らし公園

info.label: From station

places.ja: 丸福珈琲店 川崎アゼリア店

info.label: Address

info.label: Rent
info.value: Thu Jan 21 16:45 → Sat Jan 23 11:40 at Mishima

Both drivers show licence + passport; extra driver is free.

places.ja: 大黒PA
places.blurb: The famous JDM car meet in a loop of expressway ramps. Pegasis drives in himself, no guide.

info.label: Access

info.label: Closure risk
info.value: Police now close it on some weekdays too (about 3 nights a week in April 2026); Fri–Sat highest

tips: At 18:00 check X and the Shutoko closure site; if the PA is closed, drive straight to Tatsumi PA (35–40 min from Daikoku).
Food court and konbini inside: dinner here.

places.ja: 辰巳第一PA（上り）
places.blurb: A small parking area with the Tokyo skyline behind the parked cars. A short second car-meet stop on the way back.
tips: Optional: Umihotaru island in the bay adds about 1 h and a ¥3,140 toll.

places.ja: 江島神社・片瀬江ノ島駅
places.blurb: Bocchi the Rock episode 9: the band's trip to Enoshima. Red torii, stone steps, tako-senbei at Asahi Honten, and the dragon-palace Katase-Enoshima station across the bridge.

info.value: Coin car park near Enoden Enoshima / Katase-Enoshima stations (about ¥1,000–1,500): not on the island, which is 15–20 min on foot from the Enoden

tips: Park near Enoden Enoshima Station, look at the island from the Benten bridge, then take the Enoden 2 stops to the Slam Dunk crossing and back. Skip the shrine climb: the island walk alone takes 1 h 30.
Pegasis marked Enoshima not interested: it is kept to about 1 hour.
Clear winter mornings show Mt Fuji across Sagami Bay.

places.ja: 大観山（アネスト岩田ターンパイク箱根）
places.blurb: The Hakone Turnpike (14 km of smooth curves from Odawara) ends here at 1,011 m, with Mt Fuji over Lake Ashi.
tips: Ice is most common before 10:00: you drive it at about noon.
Eat lunch at the Sky Lounge at the top.

places.ja: 乙女峠
places.blurb: The Route 138 pass between Sengokuhara and Gotemba, with a big Fuji view from the Fujimi-chaya side.
tips: Stop only in the marked lay-by, not on the road.

places.ja: 富士モータースポーツミュージアム
places.blurb: A museum at the gate of Fuji Speedway with about 100 years of race cars from Toyota, Nissan, Honda and others.
tips: 20 min by car to the Gotemba outlets.

places.ja: 御殿場プレミアム・アウトレット
places.blurb: A large outlet mall with Mt Fuji behind the shops. A plain shopping stop for Pegasis.
tips: Fuji view from the Hill Side bridge.
45 minutes only: you must be over Kagosaka Pass before dark.

places.ja: 河口湖 大石公園
places.blurb: Mt Fuji straight across the lake. At sunset the snow on Fuji turns pink.
tips: Very cold after sunset; wear the ski jacket.

places.ja: HANZ OUTDOOR RESORT 河口湖
places.blurb: The one special night: a Fuji-view villa south of Lake Kawaguchi. No restaurant: the dinner is a BBQ course grilled on your villa terrace (or a no-grill dining course), and breakfast is a skillet set cooked at the villa.

info.label: Price
info.value: Villa C twin with BBQ dinner + breakfast: ¥50,800 for the room (Trip.com, Sep 28, 2026). The ¥43,159 option is a tent with one double bed

info.label: Check-in

tips: Book half board: there is little food nearby in the evening.
Choose the no-grill seasonal dining course if you do not want to grill in the cold.

places.ja: 浩庵キャンプ場（本栖湖）
places.blurb: Yuru Camp episode 1: Rin's solo camp, where Nadeshiko sees Fuji. Also the Fuji view on the ¥1,000 note.

info.label: Price
info.value: Free to look; the campsite lists ¥600 per car (not clear for short visits): keep ¥600–1,000 cash

tips: Hold a ¥1,000 note up to the view.
Roads can be icy in the morning: drive slowly.

places.ja: トヨタレンタカー 三島新幹線口店
places.blurb: Drop the car here, 2 minutes from the Shinkansen (north) gate of Mishima Station, then take the Shinkansen west.

Buy an ekiben for the train.

places.blurb: Your Osaka base: 1 night before Nagoya, then 2 nights before the Nara ryokan. Hot-spring bath and free late-night ramen.

The hot-spring bath is optional.

places.ja: 東大寺
places.blurb: The giant bronze Buddha in one of the largest wooden buildings in the world, with the Nara deer all around.
tips: Go in before 16:00.
Deer bite paper: keep maps and tickets in a pocket.

places.ja: 飛火野
places.blurb: A wide open field in Nara Park with a clear view of Wakakusa hill: fireworks at 18:15, the whole hill set on fire at 18:30.
tips: Cancelled in bad weather, with no second date.
Trains back are crowded: walk to Kintetsu-Nara by 19:15.

places.ja: 鈴鹿サーキット
places.blurb: The Japanese F1 track. In the park you drive an EV kart on the real East Course; no licence needed.

info.label: Jan 24 hours
info.value: 10:00–17:00 (official park calendar, checked Sep 26, 2026; open Jan 22–25 only)

info.value: ¥81,360 per room for 3 nights, room only = ≈ ¥40,700 per person (Rakuten, Sep 26, 2026; 9 rooms left)

info.label: Address
info.value: Kita 1-jo Nishi 2-20-5, Kutchan (pin: nearest block point)

info.label: Parking
info.value: Free car park 200 m away (map at the front)

tips: Replaces Hotel Three M: on Sep 26, 2026 it had only smoking twins left for these nights.
No staff at night: phone numbers are at the check-in machine.
The twin has a bunk bed; the sister hotel STAY LIVING NISEKO (Kita 2-jo Nishi 1) has the same rooms and price.

places.ja: セイコーマート 倶知安
places.blurb: Hokkaido's own konbini, with a Hot Chef counter that cooks katsudon and fried chicken in the shop.
tips: Buy the next breakfast here too: the hotel has no breakfast, but the room has a mini kitchen.

places.en: Grand Hirafu .Base (rental shop and ski school desk)
places.ja: グラン・ヒラフ .Base（レンタル・スクール）
places.blurb: The official rental shop at the Ace Gondola base. Rent skis, boots, poles, helmet and the ski jacket and pants here, and leave them in the daily storage overnight. Gloves and goggles you buy in Kutchan.

info.label: Ski wear
info.value: Jacket + pants ¥16,200 for 2 days (without goggles, gloves, beanie)

info.label: Your set, 2 days
info.value: ¥36,900 per person, ¥33,210 with the 10% early code (2026-27 price list)

tips: Reserve online before Oct 31, 2026 with code TGHRental109 (10% off, shown on en.grand-hirafu.jp/snow/rentals).
Daily storage: leave the gear at the shop between the two ski days.

places.ja: ニセコ東急 グラン・ヒラフ
places.blurb: The biggest Niseko slope, with light powder and Mt Yotei across the valley. Pegasis teaches Aoki on the beginner area on both days.

info.label: Lift ticket 2026–27 (Peak season, Dec 24 – Feb 28)
info.value: Hirafu & Hanazono 1 day ¥11,800 online (¥12,500 at the counter); afternoon 4 h ¥8,400 online (¥8,900) (official ticket page; online sales not open yet)

info.label: Beginner area
info.value: Ace Family area (Ace Family lift, own ticket counter at its base)

info.label: Lesson
info.value: None: Pegasis teaches Aoki (a paid group lesson is in Japanese only)

tips: Pegasis: stay on marked runs; the gates to the backcountry need avalanche gear.
Start Aoki on the flat part at the bottom of the Ace Family area: walking with skis, snowplough, stopping; ride the lift only after that.

places.ja: ルスツリゾート 雪上ドリフト
places.blurb: A closed snow course at Rusutsu with Subaru, GT-R and GR Yaris cars. You drive yourself with an instructor next to you.

info.label: Ride-along (pro drives, 4 min)
info.value: Subaru B4 ¥17,000 per person for 1–2 people; slots 8:30, 10:00, 13:00, 15:00

info.label: Booking
info.value: Prepaid, by 17:00 the day before; cancel fee 10% from booking, 50% the day before, 100% after 17:00 the day before

info.label: Reception
info.value: Rusutsu Resort activity desk (open 08:00–16:00), shuttle to the River Wood car park

tips: Email activity@rusutsu.co.jp before booking: the site asks only for a driver's licence and does not say if a 1-year licence + IDP is accepted.
Bring passport, licence and IDP; alcohol check before driving.

places.ja: スープカレー GARAKU
places.blurb: Sapporo's famous soup curry: a thin spicy soup with big chicken and grilled vegetables.
tips: Expect a queue on Sunday.
You arrive by car: use a coin car park near Nijo Market (no parking at the shop).

places.ja: トヨタレンタカー 札幌駅前店
places.blurb: Return the Hokkaido car here, 6 min on foot from JR Sapporo Station (east side, across Soseigawa-dori).
tips: Fill the tank before you return the car.

places.ja: ホテルルートイン札幌中央
places.blurb: A good-value business hotel with a public bath and free breakfast buffet, 5 min from Susukino and Daruma.

info.label: Price
info.value: Twin with breakfast ¥16,500 per room (Rakuten, Jan 31, Sep 26, 2026)

info.label: Laundry
info.value: Coin laundry in the hotel (Route Inn standard)

tips: Book the early-bird plan by about Jan 4.

places.ja: もいわ山
places.blurb: A ropeway and mini cable car to a viewpoint above the whole of Sapporo. Go up before sunset and stay for the lights.
tips: Free shuttle bus from the streetcar stop ロープウェイ入口.

places.ja: 成吉思汗だるま 本店
places.blurb: The most famous Jingisukan (grilled lamb) shop in Sapporo, since 1954: a small counter with dome pans.
tips: Cash is safest.
Your clothes will smell of lamb: wear the old jacket.

places.en: MEGA Don Quijote Sapporo Tanukikoji (24 h)
places.ja: MEGAドン・キホーテ 札幌狸小路本店
places.blurb: Last big shop before the flights: snacks, cosmetics and gifts, tax-free. Pegasis fills the suitcase here.

info.label: Tax-free
info.value: From ¥5,000 before tax, passport; refund at the airport from Nov 2026

info.label: Also
info.value: Luggage scale and a second small bag if the suitcase is full

tips: Weigh the suitcase: most checked bags must be 23 kg or less.

places.ja: 自家製麺 杵屋麦丸 成田国際空港第1ターミナル店
places.blurb: Self-service udon made in the shop, with tempura and rice balls. In the Terminal 1 Central Building, 5F, before security.
tips: Aoki eats here while he waits for Pegasis. Both flights use Terminal 1.
Other choice on T1 4F: Tonkatsu Saboten.

places.ja: 炭火串焼 かっぺ亭 新宿思い出横丁本店
places.blurb: A charcoal yakitori bar in Omoide Yokocho with 42 seats, so two people get in easily. Cheap skewers and drinks.

info.label: Hours
info.value: Mon–Fri 16:00–23:00, Sat/Sun 12:00–23:00, no closed day (Tabelog, Sep 2026; Omoide Yokocho site)

tips: Cash is safest (the Omoide site says cash only).

places.ja: 珉亭
places.blurb: An old Chinese diner famous for pink fried rice and "ra-chan" (ramen + fried rice). 2 minutes from SHELTER.
tips: Everything is cooked: good for Aoki.
60 seats: dinner takes 30–45 min.

places.ja: 魚べい 渋谷道玄坂店
places.blurb: Touch-screen sushi: plates come on an express lane. There are cooked plates too (fried chicken, egg, noodles).
tips: Aoki can order only cooked plates.

places.ja: アネスト岩田スカイラウンジ（大観山）
places.blurb: The food court and tea lounge at the top of the Hakone Turnpike, with Fuji over Lake Ashi. Ramen, soba and curry.

info.label: Hours
info.value: Food court about 09:00–16:30; 2F tea lounge weekdays 10:00–15:30

tips: No winter closing was found, but the 2027 menu is not confirmed.

places.en: Tochuken ekiben stand, Mishima Shinkansen platform
places.ja: 桃中軒 三島駅 新幹線ホーム売店
places.blurb: The local ekiben maker since 1891, with a stand on the Shinkansen platform. The Ashitaka beef sukiyaki bento is cooked, not raw.
tips: Buy it on the platform, eat it on the Kodama (3 h, no change).

places.ja: すき家 近鉄奈良駅前店
places.blurb: A fast beef-bowl chain shop next to Kintetsu-Nara Station. Quick and warm before the cold wait at the fire.
tips: Kamameshi Shizuka is not possible: last order 16:00 on Saturday.
Festival food stalls may also be open on the field.

places.ja: アドベンチャイナ（鈴鹿サーキットパーク）
places.blurb: The ramen shop in the park, in Adventure Village. Adventure Grill (burgers) and AdvenCurry are next to it.

info.label: Menu
info.value: Spicy miso ramen ¥1,250; tanmen ¥1,300; curry ¥1,500; burger ¥1,270 (official foods page)

tips: Which park restaurants open on Jan 22–25 is not published: check the foods page in January.

places.ja: 松屋 日本橋店
places.blurb: A 24-hour gyudon chain shop by Nippombashi Station, 11 min on foot from the apartment. Hot Japanese breakfast sets for about ¥500.
tips: Order at the ticket machine by the door.
The hotel buffet costs ¥2,500 per person: here it is one fifth.

places.en: Shirakaba Sanso ramen, Hokkaido Ramen Dojo (New Chitose)
places.ja: 麺処 白樺山荘 新千歳空港店
places.blurb: Sapporo miso ramen in the Ramen Dojo, domestic terminal 3F, before security. Fast: 30 minutes is enough.
tips: Pin is the terminal point.

places.ja: ラーメン店 なかま
places.blurb: A local ramen shop by Kutchan Station, open late.

info.label: Hours
info.value: Mon, Thu, Fri, Sat 11:00–14:00 / 17:00–24:00; Sun 11:00–24:00; closed Tue, Wed (Tabelog)

tips: Closes early if the soup runs out.

places.ja: 望羊荘
places.blurb: An old family lodge on the lower Hirafu slopes with cheap katsu curry and ramen, much cheaper than the resort restaurants.
tips: 2026–27 hours not confirmed.

places.ja: POWDERHOOD RESTAURANT & TAPROOM（ALPEN NODE）
places.blurb: Burgers and hot food in ALPEN NODE at the Ace Gondola base plaza, 5 min from .Base.

info.label: Hours
info.value: Winter daytime from about 10:30 (two sources disagree on the closing time)

tips: Backup: the food court in the Hirafu Welcome Center.

places.ja: 居酒屋 餃子の肉村
places.blurb: A small local gyoza izakaya in Kutchan town. House gyoza at local prices.
tips: Opens at 18:00.

places.ja: 奈良公園
places.blurb: About 1,300 free-roaming deer on open grass between Kofukuji and Kasuga Taisha. Buy crackers and the deer bow to you for them.
tips: Show empty hands when the crackers are finished, or the deer keep pushing.
Deer bite paper: keep maps and tickets in a pocket.

places.ja: とんかつ がんこ 奈良店
places.blurb: A tonkatsu restaurant of the Ganko chain on the Higashimuki shopping street, 5 minutes from Kintetsu-Nara. Early dinner before the hill fire.

info.label: Hours
info.value: 11:00–21:15 (last order 20:45), every day (gankofood.co.jp and Google Maps, Sep 26, 2026)

tips: Come at 16:00: after 17:00 the festival crowd fills the street.

places.ja: スポーツたきぐち
places.blurb: A local ski and sports shop on the station street in Kutchan, 2 min from your hotel. Buy ski gloves and goggles here for all 3 ski days.
tips: Backup: Bigban Winter Sports in Kutchan (used gear, 10:00–19:00 every day).
Buy a beanie too if you have no warm hat: the helmet goes over it.

places.ja: 矢場とん 名古屋駅エスカ店
places.blurb: The Nagoya miso-katsu chain in the ESCA underground mall on the Shinkansen side of Nagoya Station: dinner 3 min from the platform.
tips: Table bookings are possible: useful on a Sunday evening.

places.ja: 鵬天閣 新館
places.blurb: Yokohama Chinatown, the biggest in Japan: 500+ shops inside 4 painted gates. Dinner at Hotenkaku, known for pan-fried xiaolongbao (焼き小籠包), then a walk to the Kanteibyo temple lit up at night.
tips: The pan-fried xiaolongbao are very hot inside: bite a small hole first.

places.ja: 江戸三
places.blurb: A ryokan of small separate cottages inside Nara Park, opened in 1907. Deer walk past your door. Tatami room, yukata, and dinner served in your room.

info.label: Night
info.value: Wed Jan 27, the last night before the flight (a room was free on Rakuten, Sep 27, 2026)

info.label: Price
info.value: "Wakakusa nabe" hot-pot plan, fully cooked: ¥61,600 for 2 with dinner and breakfast (kaiseki plan ¥57,200 has sashimi) (Rakuten, Sep 26, 2026)

info.label: Access
info.value: Kintetsu-Nara 15 min on foot; Osaka-Namba about 40 min by Kintetsu

tips: Book the hot-pot plan and write "no raw fish, cooked food only" in the booking note.
Email first: ask if they accept 2 suitcases by Yamato on Jan 27 before check-in.
The cottage rooms have their own toilet; the bath is shared.
Jan 28: breakfast at 08:00, then ask them to call a taxi to JR Nara for the 09:15 airport bus.

places.ja: 松阪牛焼肉M 法善寺横丁店
places.blurb: Top Matsusaka beef grilled at your table, in the old stone lane of Hozenji Yokocho next to Dotonbori. The special dinner of the trip.
tips: Book a table for 18:30 on Tue Jan 26.
Check its closed day on TableCheck before you book.
Everything is cooked on the grill: fine for Aoki.

places.ja: 京都拉麺小路
places.blurb: A floor of ramen shops from all over Japan on the 10th floor of the Kyoto Station building. Buy a ticket at the machine, sit, eat.
tips: Take the escalators on the west side of the Station building up to 10F.

places.ja: 串かつだるま 道頓堀店
places.blurb: Osaka deep-fried skewers (kushikatsu) at the famous Daruma chain. No second dip in the sauce!
tips: After dinner walk the small bars of Ura-Namba if you still have energy.

places.ja: 忠犬ハチ公像
places.blurb: The meeting place in Girls Band Cry episode 3, at the Shibuya Scramble crossing.

places.ja: 渋谷PARCO
places.blurb: Nintendo's and Pokémon's big Tokyo shops on one floor.

places.en: Yako: Shinmei Shrine and station area
places.ja: 神明神社（矢向）・矢向駅
places.blurb: Nina's home area in Girls Band Cry: the shrine from episodes 12–13 and the Yako Station streets. Quiet, local, and near the Nambu Line.

info.label: Station
info.value: 矢向駅 (JR Nambu Line), 10 min walk

places.ja: 麺や ふくわらい
places.blurb: A small local ramen shop 4 minutes from JR Yako Station, on the Girls Band Cry walk.

info.label: Hours
info.value: About 07:00–14:00 (Google); Tabelog also shows 11:30–14:30; closed Tuesday

tips: Arrive by 13:05: it closes at about 14:00.

places.ja: 伊勢丹 新宿店
places.blurb: The basement food hall of Isetan. From about 19:00 sushi, bento and deli food get 20–50% stickers before the 20:00 close.
tips: Brand counters do not always cut prices; look at the bento and sushi counters.

places.ja: 明治神宮
places.blurb: A big Shinto shrine in a forest in the middle of Tokyo, 1 min from Harajuku Station. A wide gravel path under tall trees to the main hall.

info.label: Hours
info.value: Sunrise to sunset (about 6:40–16:20 in January); free

tips: The walk from the gate to the main hall takes 10 min.

places.ja: 竹下通り
places.blurb: Harajuku's narrow street of fashion shops, crêpes and sweets, full of young people. Cheap fun shops and street snacks.
tips: On a Tuesday morning it is much quieter than at the weekend.

places.ja: 新宿ゴールデン街
places.blurb: Six narrow lanes of about 200 tiny bars, each with 5–10 seats. One drink in a bar that welcomes visitors.
tips: Look for signs "Welcome" or a posted cover charge at the door; some bars are for regulars only.

places.en: Super Hotel Nagoya Tennen Onsen Shinkansen-guchi
places.ja: 天然温泉 名城金鯱の湯 スーパーホテル名古屋天然温泉 新幹線口
places.romaji: Sūpā Hoteru Nagoya Tennen Onsen Shinkansen-guchi
places.blurb: One night in Nagoya between Suzuka and Ghibli Park: a small twin with a hot-spring bath and a fresh-bread breakfast buffet, 7 min from Nagoya Station.

info.label: Price
info.value: Twin with breakfast ¥12,540–13,200 for the room (Rakuten, Sep 27, 2026; 4 left)

info.label: Room
info.value: Small twin, 12 m²: fine for one night with small bags

info.label: Access
info.value: 7 min on foot from Nagoya Station, Taiko-dori (Shinkansen) side

tips: Your suitcases stay in the Osaka apartment tonight: bring one small bag each.

places.en: Osu Kannon and the Osu shopping streets
places.ja: 大須観音・大須商店街
places.blurb: Nagoya's old temple and the covered shopping streets around it: anime goods, figures, retro games, used clothes and street food.
tips: Sunday evening: go straight to the figure and game shops, they close first.

places.ja: 矢場とん 矢場町本店
places.blurb: The main shop of the miso katsu chain: a pork cutlet under sweet red miso sauce.
tips: Order the waraji tonkatsu (plate-sized) to share, or the classic miso katsu.

places.ja: ジブリパーク
places.blurb: Studio Ghibli's park in Expo 2005 Aichi Commemorative Park: the Grand Warehouse, Satsuki and Mei's house, the Valley of Witches (Howl and Kiki) and Mononoke Village.

info.value: Mon Jan 25 (the park is closed on Tuesdays)

tips: The Grand Warehouse has a set entry time on the ticket: plan the day around it.
Hot food at the Valley of Witches stalls for lunch.

places.ja: ホテルルートイン河口湖
places.blurb: A plain business hotel on the east side of Lake Kawaguchi, with a Fuji-and-lake-side twin, a natural hot-spring bath and dinner in the hotel restaurant.

info.label: Price
info.value: Twin, Mt Fuji & lake side, dinner + breakfast: ¥27,300 for the room (Trip.com, Sep 28, 2026)

info.label: Has
info.value: Natural hot-spring bath, free parking, coin laundry; own toilet and bath in the room

tips: Tell the hotel you arrive about 17:45 and want dinner at 18:30.
A no-view twin with breakfast only was ¥14,200, if you want to save more.

places.ja: アパートメントホテル 11 黒門
places.blurb: Your Osaka home for 4 nights: a whole apartment by Kuromon Market with 2 double beds, a kitchen and a washer-dryer. The suitcases stay here while you sleep in Nagoya.

info.label: Nights
info.value: Jan 23 – 27 (4 nights, one booking; you sleep in Nagoya on Jan 24)

info.label: Room
info.value: 2 double beds, 1.5 baths, kitchen, washer + dryer, elevator

tips: No front desk: the suitcases from Tokyo wait at a Yamato office, and you collect them on Jan 23.
Jan 26 evening: send both suitcases to Edosan from a 7-Eleven or FamilyMart (Yamato).
Location on the map is approximate (Airbnb shows the exact address after booking).

places.ja: ニセコ コンテナハウス（ニセコ nalu）
places.blurb: A whole container unit in Niseko town, run by Niseko nalu guesthouse: 2 double beds, its own shower and toilet, a small kitchen and free parking. About 20–25 min by car to Grand Hirafu.

Phone early to reserve the parking space for the night of Jan 21.

places.ja: ホテルマイステイズ清澄白河
places.blurb: Your Tokyo base for 4 nights in quiet east Tokyo, 5 min from Kiyosumi-shirakawa Station (Hanzomon and Oedo lines: Shinjuku in 30 min, Otemachi in 7). A standard twin with its own bath; no breakfast.

places.ja: やきとり道場 清澄白河店
places.blurb: A plain yakitori izakaya 5 min from the hotel, open late every day.

places.ja: ブルーボトルコーヒー 清澄白河フラッグシップカフェ
places.blurb: The first Blue Bottle in Japan, in an old warehouse with the roastery inside. Coffee and pastries for a slow breakfast.

places.ja: 清澄庭園
places.blurb: A Meiji-era stroll garden around a big pond, with stepping stones across the water and a teahouse on the shore.

places.ja: 深川江戸資料館
places.blurb: A full-size Edo-period street indoors: you walk into the houses, the rice shop and the boat inn, with light changing from day to night.

places.ja: 深川釜匠
places.blurb: The local dish: fukagawa-meshi, clams cooked in miso broth over rice. All cooked, fine for Aoki.

places.ja: 錦糸公園
places.blurb: The park by Kinshicho Station from Bocchi the Rock!: the bench and the lawn where Kikuri drinks and Bocchi first plays on the street.

tips: Buy a 60–70 L suitcase with 4 wheels: it must hold everything Pegasis buys until Feb 1.
places.ja: ドン・キホーテ 錦糸町北口店
places.blurb: A big Don Quijote next to Kinshi Park. Pegasis buys the suitcase for the way home here; Aoki can use the tourist coupon.

places.ja: スーパーポテト 秋葉原店
places.blurb: Three floors of retro games, consoles and figures, with a small retro arcade on the top floor.

tips: Evenings can have a queue: take a queue ticket on the site.

info.label: Cost
info.value: Entry fee + a drink, about ¥2,000–3,000 each

places.ja: あっとほぉーむカフェ
places.blurb: The classic Akihabara maid café, next door to Super Potato: a drink or a dessert, a photo with a maid, a small game.

info.label: Hours
info.value: Food hall closes about 19:00–19:30 (not checked: see the store site)

places.ja: 日本橋三越本店 デパ地下
places.blurb: Japan's oldest department store. Near closing, the food hall marks down sushi rolls, bento and cooked dishes.

tips: Check out on Feb 1 at about 09:55 for the JR airport train.

info.label: Price
info.value: Your booking (not written in the plan yet)

places.ja: 札幌エクセルホテル東急
places.blurb: Your last 2 nights: a Tokyu hotel south of Susukino, 5 min on foot from Nakajima-koen Station (Namboku Line: Sapporo Station in 6 min). Daruma, Tanukikoji and the ramen alley are 10 min away.

info.label: Cost

places.ja: めいどりーみん 札幌狸小路店
places.blurb: The Sapporo shop of the maid café chain, above the covered Tanukikoji arcade: a drink, a dessert and a short stage show.

places.ja: 元祖さっぽろラーメン横丁
places.blurb: A narrow lane in Susukino with about 15 small ramen shops: Sapporo miso ramen, butter corn, crab ramen. Pick the shortest queue.

days.title: Land in Tokyo, airport bus to Tokyo Station, late yakitori by the hotel
days.titleJa: 成田空港 → 東京駅 → 清澄白河
days.summary: Pegasis lands first and waits at Narita Terminal 1 with an early udon; Aoki lands at 18:10 and you travel together from there. The airport bus drops you at Tokyo Station for the Girls Band Cry dome, a taxi to the hotel in Kiyosumi-shirakawa, then a late yakitori dinner 5 minutes away.
alerts: Pegasis: at immigration ask for a paper landing stamp, not the face-scan gate (the car shop checks it on Jan 21).
Hotel front desk closes at 22:00: take the taxi at about 20:50. If you are late, phone the hotel (03-5624-2641).

stops.note: Pegasis lands (WestJet, Terminal 1): immigration with a paper landing stamp, cash, Welcome Suica, eSIM.
Pegasis: early light dinner (udon), 30 min, while he waits. Aoki's breakfast and lunch are in Shanghai (CA919 has no meal).
Aoki lands 18:10 (Air China CA919, Terminal 1). Meet in the T1 arrivals lobby; Aoki buys an onigiri at the konbini.
Girls Band Cry ep 1: Nina arrives under this dome, 10 min (Aoki's pick).
Check in before 22:00; drop the suitcases.
Dinner: yakitori and a beer, 1 h (last order 23:00).

notes: One plan for both: Pegasis waits at Narita (about 2.5 h) instead of going ahead alone; the station dome is Aoki's want, the airport bus is Pegasis's. Omoide Yokocho yakitori moves to day 3, after the live show.

alerts: Taxi from Edosan at about 08:55 for the 09:15 airport bus at JR Nara (East exit, stop 4). Reserve bus seats online.
You reach Kutchan at about 16:45, after dark: drive slowly on snow. Leave the car shop by 14:30 for the Lake Shikotsu road; later, or if it snows, take Route 5 via Otaru.

stops.note: Breakfast in your room, 40 min; check out.
JAL 11:45 → New Chitose 13:30 (North Terminal). Buy a bento or onigiri for lunch at the gate.
Land; take the bags.
Pick up the 4WD car (book it for 14:10).
Buy ski gloves and goggles for both (≈ ¥6,000–10,000 each), 30 min. Open to 19:00 on weekdays (Thursday).
Dinner: local ramen, 40 min.
Buy tomorrow's breakfast, 15 min.
Check in (check-in until 21:00).

legs.label: Taxi to JR Nara East exit (ask the ryokan to call one, about 10 min, ≈ ¥1,000); Nara Kotsu airport bus, JR Nara 09:15 → Itami North Terminal (JAL) 10:46 (¥1,750)
JAL, Itami 11:45 → New Chitose 13:30
Toyota Rent a Car counter in arrivals, then the free shuttle bus, about 14:00
Drive, Route 36 → Route 276 via Lake Shikotsu, Kimobetsu, Kyogoku → Kutchan; park at the shop
Walk along the station street
Walk
Back to the car, then Route 5 south to Niseko town

days.sleepNote: Night 1 of 2 in the Niseko container house (2 double beds, own shower and toilet).
notes: Pegasis drives every leg (Aoki's Chinese licence is not valid in Japan): take a 10-min break at Lake Shikotsu or Kimobetsu.
If you leave the car shop after 14:30 or it snows hard, drive via Sapporo and Otaru (Route 5), about 2 h 45.
Sunset in Kutchan is about 16:40.
The container house is in Niseko town, 20 min south of Kutchan: you eat and shop in Kutchan on the way.
days.cost: ≈ ¥26,000 per person (JAL ¥13,030, airport bus ¥1,750, taxi share ¥500, car day 1 and fuel split, meals); ski gloves and goggles ≈ ¥6,000–10,000 each

days.title: Grand Hirafu: rent everything, Pegasis teaches Aoki to ski
days.titleJa: ニセコ東急 グラン・ヒラフ（レンタル・初心者エリア）
days.summary: Rent all the gear at .Base and ski together all day on the Ace Family beginner area: Pegasis teaches Aoki. Lunch in an old lodge on the slope, back in Kutchan before dark.
alerts: Rental reserved online (with the 10% code); buy lift tickets online when sales open.
Rusutsu drift (tomorrow 15:00) booked in advance after the licence email.
Leave the container house at 10:30; take your gloves and goggles.

stops.note: Breakfast in the unit (Seicomart food from last night), no rush.
Pick up the reserved rental: skis, boots, poles, helmet, jacket + pants. Buy lift tickets. Wear your own gloves and goggles.
Pegasis teaches Aoki on the Ace Family area: walking on skis, snowplough, stopping, then the Ace Family lift.
Lunch: katsu curry or ramen in the old lodge, 50 min.
Afternoon runs together on the Ace Family area; gear in .Base storage by 15:50.
Dinner: Hot Chef katsudon and fried chicken to take away; buy tomorrow's breakfast.
Back before full dark; dinner in the unit.

legs.label: Drive, Route 5 north, then Route 343 up to the Hirafu base car park
Walk to the lifts
Ski or walk down to the lodge
Walk back to the lift
Leave the gear in .Base storage, drive down to Kutchan
Route 5 south to Niseko town

days.sleepNote: Night 2 of 2 in the Niseko container house. Pack tonight: tomorrow you drive on to Sapporo.
notes: Lift ticket (peak season): Hirafu & Hanazono 1 day ¥11,800 online each (¥12,500 at the counter).
Rental per person for both days: ¥36,900 (skis, boots, poles, helmet, jacket and pants), ¥33,210 with the early code. Gloves and goggles are your own (bought in Kutchan yesterday).
No paid lesson: Pegasis teaches Aoki. If Aoki wants a pro later, an English private lesson costs from ¥40,000 for 2 h.
days.cost: ≈ ¥32,000 per person (lift ¥11,800, half of the 2-day rental ≈ ¥16,600, lunch, dinner, fuel)

days.title: Morning ski at Hirafu, Rusutsu snow drift course at 15:00, Nakayama Pass to Sapporo, Jingisukan
days.titleJa: ニセコ グラン・ヒラフ → ルスツ 雪上ドリフト → 中山峠 → 札幌
days.romaji: Niseko Gran Hirafu → Rusutsu → Nakayama-tōge → Sapporo
days.summary: Check out with all the bags in the car, a last morning of skiing and lunch at Hirafu, then the snow drift course at Rusutsu. Over Nakayama Pass to Sapporo, the car in the hotel car park, and Jingisukan at Daruma for dinner.
alerts: Breath test before the drift course: no alcohol the night before.
Pegasis: licence + IDP + passport. Leave Rusutsu by 15:50.
Nakayama Pass after dark (sunset about 16:40): drive slowly. If the pass is closed or it snows hard, take Route 5 via Otaru (about 2 h 30).
Check out at 10:00 with all the bags in the car (Saturday: park at Hirafu lot 1).

stops.note: Breakfast in the unit (Seicomart food); check out at 10:00.
Take the gear out of storage; buy lift tickets.
Ski together until 12:15 on the Ace Family area.
Return all the rental gear.
Lunch: burgers at the gondola base, 35 min; leave at 13:20.
Check in at the Rusutsu Resort activity desk (open to 16:00). 15:00 Introduction Course: Pegasis drives 30 min with the instructor; Aoki in the back seat.
Check in; park in the hotel car park; drop the bags.
Dinner: Jingisukan at the counter (both of you wanted it).

Walk to the lifts
Walk down to .Base

days.sleepNote: Night 1 of 2 in Sapporo (Sapporo Excel Hotel Tokyu).
notes: The 30-min self-drive (Introduction Course) runs only at 15:00. The 10:00 slot has only the 4-min ride-along or the 75-min Driving Course (¥61,000).
Aoki option: a 4-min ride-along with the pro in the same 15:00 slot costs ¥17,000 per person instead of the ¥10,000 back seat.
Leave Hirafu at 13:30 at the latest; Saturday ski traffic.
Nikuson and the Kutchan Seicomart are out: after the drift you drive straight to Sapporo.
days.cost: ≈ ¥64,000 Pegasis (Introduction Course ¥31,000, lift ¥11,800, half of the rental ≈ ¥16,600, fuel, meals), ≈ ¥43,000 Aoki (back seat ¥10,000, lift, rental, fuel, meals)

days.title: A slow Sapporo day: tax-free shopping, soup curry, a maid café, Mt Moiwa at sunset, miso ramen
days.titleJa: 狸小路 → スープカレー GARAKU → めいどりーみん → もいわ山 → ラーメン横丁
days.romaji: Tanukikōji → GARAKU → Meidorīmin → Moiwa-yama → Rāmen Yokochō
days.summary: The car back at Sapporo Station in the morning, then no car and no rush. Last tax-free shopping in the covered Tanukikoji arcade, soup curry at GARAKU, a maid café, then the streetcar and ropeway up Mt Moiwa for the sunset and the night view. Miso ramen in the ramen alley, then pack for the flights.
alerts: GARAKU: lunch time queue; a table often frees in 20–30 min.
Laundry night 4: clean clothes for the flights.

stops.note: Breakfast: hotel buffet (paid) or a konbini.
Return the car with a full tank.
Last tax-free shopping in the arcade; Pegasis fills and weighs the suitcase, 1 h.
Lunch: soup curry (Minami 3-jo Higashi 2, B1F); expect a short queue (Pegasis's pick).
Maid café: a drink and a dessert, 1 h (from your ideas list).
Up before sunset (about 16:45), night view (both of you wanted it).
Dinner: Sapporo miso ramen in the ramen alley, 45 min.

Walk east along Tanukikoji, then north-east to Minami 3-jo Higashi 2
Walk back west to Tanukikoji 4-chome

Free shuttle bus down; Sapporo Streetcar Loop (inner), Ropeway-iriguchi about 17:35 → Susukino 18:02; walk 5 min
Walk south

days.sleepNote: Night 2 of 2 in Sapporo. Pack and weigh the bags tonight.
notes: After 10:00 no car: everything is on foot or by streetcar.
Other choice for lunch or dinner: SHO-RIN soup curry (from your ideas list).
Sapporo Snow Festival starts Feb 4, after you leave.
days.cost: ≈ ¥11,000 per person (fuel, soup curry, maid café ≈ ¥2,500, Moiwa ¥2,100 + streetcar, ramen); goods extra

days.title: Fly Sapporo → Narita together, last lunch, fly home from Narita
days.titleJa: 札幌 → 新千歳空港 → 成田空港
days.summary: A 10:00 check-out, the JR train to New Chitose and one Peach flight to Narita Terminal 1, the terminal of both flights home. Last shopping and an early dinner together at Narita, then Pegasis flies at 18:30 and Aoki at 19:30.
alerts: Check out at 09:55 with all bags; day 15 of 15 on Aoki's visa (Feb 1).
Peach: add the checked bags when you book (not at the airport: more expensive).
Tax-free refund check at customs before bag drop at Narita.

stops.note: Breakfast: hotel buffet (paid) or a konbini; check out at 09:55.
Peach counter (domestic terminal): bag drop. Lunch: buy a Hokkaido ekiben (boxed lunch) to eat on the plane.
Land at Terminal 1 (Peach MM576). Bag storage for the suitcases.
Last shopping in T1: souvenirs, snacks, Japan-only goods; Pegasis weighs the suitcase.
Pegasis checks in for WestJet WS81 18:30 (with the suitcase).
Dinner together: T1 restaurant floor (Central Building 4F–5F), 45 min.
Aoki checks in for Air China CA920 19:30. Say goodbye about 17:00.

legs.label: Walk to Nakajima-koen (5 min); Namboku Line, Nakajima-koen about 10:02 → Sapporo 10:08; JR Rapid Airport, Sapporo about 10:30 → New Chitose Airport 11:07 (¥1,230)
Peach MM576, New Chitose 12:00 → Narita Terminal 1 13:50

notes: You stay together until about 16:45: both flights home leave from Narita Terminal 1.
Backup: Peach MM574 11:10 → 13:00 (leave 09:15), or Jetstar GK110 12:45 → 14:30 (Terminal 3; free bus to T1, 14 min).
Peach fare about ¥7,990 each (Google Flights, Sep 26, 2026) plus a checked bag (about ¥2,000–3,500 when booked online).
Chinese New Year is Feb 6: Narita will be busy on Feb 1; keep 3 h for Aoki's check-in.
days.cost: ≈ ¥15,000 per person (JR ¥1,230, Peach ¥7,990 + bag, lunch, dinner)
